ability.value:
-1 cost per Business
If a creature does not use abilities usages and/or actions by the end of the global turn, they are stored inside this item for later use by the same creature. (no MAX)
Will store individual uses of a muli-use (XTP) abilities.
Stored actions/ability`s cooldowns refresh as they were used.
Cannot store passives abilities.
If negated, stored charges aren’t lost, but cannot be withdrawn.
If destroyed, stored charges are lost.
